n01.text: Need a score for your trailer? Ask Claude.

n03.text: A self-improving music agent for anything. One MCP away.

n04.text: And it checks its own work, from the audio, before anyone listens.

n06.text: It said 127 BPM. The audio said 172.

n07.text: So we built it a self-check.

v05.text: Four studios at once. Every beat tested against the brief.

v06.text: Then a Nemotron coach on Crusoe rewrites Miles's own playbook.

n08.text: Every change has to win. Or it's gone.

n09.text: Six ideas. Three would have made it worse. The gate caught all three.

v13.text: Miles N plus one. Music that checks itself.
